args:
while true; do
  if psql -h postgres -U billing -d billing -tAc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf 'ok\n' > /state/db-status.next
  else
    printf 'auth_error\n' > /state/db-status.next
  fi
  mv /state/db-status.next /state/db-status
  sleep 0.2
done
containers.name: db-auth-checker

args:
printf "ALTER ROLE billing WITH PASSWORD '%s';\n" "${NEXT_PASSWORD}" \
  | psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h postgres -U billing -d billing >/dev/null 2>&1
generation_hash="$(printf '%s' "${NEXT_PASSWORD}" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')"
printf '{"rotation":"complete","generation_sha256":"%s"}\n' "${generation_hash}"

payload.rationale: The rotate-db-password Job rotated the PostgreSQL database password to match db-credentials, leaving billing-credentials stale and causing db-auth-checker and billing-api database authentication to fail. Synchronizing billing-credentials from authoritative db-credentials and triggering a controlled rollout of billing-api resolves the authentication failure without disclosing secret data.
payload.rollback_trigger: billing-api HTTP 5xx error rate exceeds 0.001, p95 latency exceeds 200ms, or database authentication continues to be rejected after rollout.

success_criteria.description: billing-api /billing endpoint returns HTTP 200 with database_auth accepted, db-auth-checker reports ok status, and HTTP 5xx rate remains below 0.001 across 3 consecutive evaluation windows.
